comment: Bundled plant list for Loopr plants per week. A plant is a whole or minimally processed plant food a person eats, counted once per ISO week by key. Counted: vegetables, fruits, legumes, whole grains, nuts, seeds, herbs, spices and mushrooms. Herbs and spices count as plants (the common 30 plants a week counting), and so do mushrooms. Not counted: refined products such as sugar, syrups, oils, white flour, white bread, white rice, plain pasta and starches, and drinks such as coffee, tea and cocoa. A plant matches Open Food Facts ingredients through offIds, the taxonomy ids from https://static.openfoodfacts.org/data/taxonomies/ingredients.json. Open Food Facts lists parent ingredients with each ingredient, so an entry lists only ids that are specific and whole. offSuppressedBy names a more specific ingredient whose presence drops this more general plant, so kale does not also count as cabbage. Generic ids such as en:wheat, en:wheat-flour, en:rice, en:vegetable-oil, en:sugar and en:cereal are deliberately not listed.
